blocks.task_summary: Show x-coordinates of P and Q satisfy given equation; hence find coordinates of P and Q.
method_path: Set numerator of dy/dx to zero: 2x - e^{x+y} = 0
Express y in terms of x: y = ln(2x) - x
Substitute into curve equation x^2 + y^2 = e^{x+y} to get equation in x
Solve equation numerically for x, obtaining 0.331 and 1.84
Find corresponding y using y = ln(2x) - x, giving (0.331, -0.743) and (1.84, -0.538)
